text: {"features":[{"evidence":"too many signals, too few experts","name":"role-specific narrative","description":"This dimension captures how clearly and memorably the letter explains why this exact security engineering role fits the applicant's motivations and prior work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Could fit many software roles and mostly reads as a generic application."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some interest in security, backend work, or Google, but the motivation remains fairly broad."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly connects the applicant's interests to one or two responsibilities of this role."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses a distinctive framing and threads it through the letter to make the fit with this role feel specific and convincing."}]},{"evidence":"improvements there are inherited by every team downstream","name":"platform leverage motivation","description":"This dimension measures how strongly the applicant is motivated by central infrastructure work whose impact propagates across many teams or users.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention platform, foundational, or multiplier-style impact."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions scale or broad impact in general terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly says they want to work on foundational or central systems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly frames both past work and future goals around multiplier effects, inherited improvements, or company-wide leverage."}]},{"evidence":"the secure thing by default","name":"developer enablement orientation","description":"This dimension captures whether the applicant frames security work as making the secure path easier for other engineers through tooling, defaults, and reduced friction.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no real developer-enablement perspective."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses a general desire to help teams or improve security."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly values making secure behavior easier for engineers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly centers security tooling, defaults, and friction reduction as the mechanism for improving developer behavior."}]},{"evidence":"7 years ... launched 6 production services","name":"software delivery scope","description":"This dimension captures the depth of claimed production engineering experience through years, service ownership, launches, maintenance, and testing.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Barely above the minimum, with limited scope across production systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows moderate production experience across a few services."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a strong multi-year track record across several production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows extensive production scope, combining longer tenure, repeated launches, and broad system exposure."}]},{"evidence":"Doctoral degree in computer science","name":"academic preparation","description":"This dimension reflects the highest formal computer science training claimed in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Bachelor's degree or equivalent level of formal training."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Master's degree or equivalent graduate training."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Doctoral degree or equivalent research training."}]},{"evidence":"Go as my daily driver","name":"Go backend grounding","description":"This dimension measures how strongly the letter establishes Go as a meaningful production language for backend systems rather than a token qualification.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Lists Go, but gives little sense of what was built with it."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows regular production use of Go."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a primary or most-used language."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Ties Go directly to backend infrastructure or to the specific systems described in the letter."}]},{"evidence":"Python is all over my recent work","name":"Python engineering depth","description":"This dimension captures the extent to which Python is presented as a serious working language for services, automation, and tooling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no Python evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python briefly, but without showing real use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for services, automation, or analysis."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents Python as production-grade, with evidence such as tested services, typed tooling, or broad operational ownership."}]},{"evidence":"turned an unstructured queue into a routed, prioritized pipeline","name":"vulnerability triage automation","description":"This dimension measures evidence of having built tooling that automates the intake, classification, routing, deduplication, or prioritization of vulnerability reports.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no relevant security automation example."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in security automation or mentions report handling vaguely."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States direct experience automating vulnerability intake or triage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives a concrete pipeline example involving routing, prioritization, deduplication, or classification and makes the ownership clear."}]},{"evidence":"Python agents ... Go services keep every action inside well-marked lines","name":"agentic system design","description":"This dimension captures evidence of designing agent-based systems with autonomous behavior, boundaries, supervision, permissions, or auditability.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no agentic or autonomous-system evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI automation, but not agent architecture."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agent-based systems or Python agents in a meaningful way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains an end-to-end agent architecture with explicit constraints, permissions, supervision, or auditability."}]},{"evidence":"evaluation scaffolding required to deploy them responsibly","name":"production AI deployment","description":"This dimension measures experience using AI or LLMs in real systems, especially with attention to reliability, evaluation, or failure modes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no AI evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows interest in AI, but no shipped work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Claims shipped AI or LLM-backed features or integrations."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows shipped AI work plus explicit attention to evaluation, trustworthiness, correctness, or failure-mode handling."}]},{"evidence":"threat models and follow-through","name":"security assessment practice","description":"This dimension captures evidence of conducting structured security reviews, threat modeling, code review, or remediation verification.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no assessment or review evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows security interest, but assessment work is unclear or indirect."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience with security assessments, threat models, reviews, or code analysis."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes structured or hands-on assessment practice with clear method, attacker perspective, or remediation follow-through."}]},{"evidence":"turned a brute-force correlation job into a streaming computation","name":"algorithmic fluency","description":"This dimension measures how convincingly the letter shows practical command of data structures and algorithms through concrete engineering examples.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no algorithm or data-structure evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Makes only a generic claim of strength with algorithms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one concrete example of an algorithmic or data-structure improvement."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates current, applied fluency through a technically specific redesign or performance improvement."}]},{"evidence":"capture-the-flag competitions ... near the top","name":"offensive security practice","description":"This dimension captures evidence of hands-on offensive security skill-building outside normal development work, especially through CTF participation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions no offensive security practice."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions casual or occasional practice without depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows ongoing serious practice, such as regular CTF participation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows especially strong or purposeful practice, such as near-top placements or a clear attacker-skill development routine."}]},{"evidence":"earned the OSCP certification","name":"security credential level","description":"This dimension reflects the strength of formal security certification claims, from none to baseline knowledge to hands-on offensive credentials.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No security certification is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a baseline credential that signals foundational knowledge, such as Security+."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions an advanced practical credential that signals hands-on offensive skill, such as OSCP."}]},{"evidence":"maintainer of an open-source tooling project","name":"open-source stewardship","description":"This dimension measures the extent of engagement with external codebases, from occasional fixes to maintaining projects with releases, users, and reviews.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions no open-source activity."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional upstream fixes or bug patches."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular contributions or maintenance of a small project."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear stewardship of an external project, library, or framework with users, releases, reviews, or community interaction."}]},{"evidence":"built a fault-tolerant message broker from scratch","name":"personal systems project ambition","description":"This dimension captures how substantial and technically demanding the applicant's self-directed projects appear outside their day job.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions no side project work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions only a small utility or simple personal app."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a substantive standalone project with real engineering effort."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows an ambitious infrastructure-style project emphasizing distributed systems, consistency, recovery, or other hard systems problems."}]},{"evidence":"someone always inherits what we build","name":"maintainer mindset","description":"This dimension measures whether the letter conveys a bias toward durability, operability, and long-term system care rather than only feature delivery.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows little indication of long-term care or reliability thinking."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at maintenance experience, but does not develop it into a clear perspective."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly values reliability, inheritance, or ongoing system care."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Makes the maintainer's perspective a strong throughline that shapes how the applicant describes design choices and engineering standards."}]},{"evidence":"deduplicating findings and routing them to the owning teams","name":"evidence specificity","description":"This dimension captures how much the letter supports its claims with concrete mechanisms, examples, or outcomes rather than generic assertions of fit.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mostly offers abstract claims or requirement matching with little concrete support."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Provides a few specifics, but many claims remain general."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides several concrete examples showing what was built or improved."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is consistently concrete, giving mechanisms, context, and outcomes that make the claims easy to trust."}]},{"evidence":"Sofwtare Engineer","name":"writing polish","description":"This dimension captures the level of proofreading and surface clarity in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent distracting errors or awkward wording that materially undermines confidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains multiple noticeable typos or slips, though the meaning remains clear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Is mostly polished, with only minor occasional errors."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Reads as clean, careful, and professionally proofread prose."}]}]}
